quick_facts.label: What the job is
quick_facts.value: Transportation, storage and distribution managers plan, direct or coordinate transportation, storage or distribution activities; the occupation includes logistics managers.

quick_facts.label: Other names for it
quick_facts.value: Job titles O*NET reports for this occupation (Transportation, Storage, and Distribution Managers) include Logistics Operations Manager, Distribution Manager, Distribution Center Manager and Supply Chain Logistics Manager.

sections.heading: What a logistics manager does
paragraphs: Transportation, storage and distribution managers plan, direct or coordinate transportation, storage or distribution activities; the occupation includes logistics managers.

The tasks below are taken from the O*NET profile for Transportation, Storage, and Distribution Managers. O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Supervise the people who receive, store, test and ship products or materials.
Plan and run warehouse safety and security programmes.
Work with other departments to connect logistics with business systems or processes, such as customer sales.
Analyse the company's logistics to find the most cost-effective way to move goods.
